# Account draft image storage implementation brief

Source: Desktop checkout, inspected 2026-10-27. Planning only; no application edits, database actions, or test execution. Scope: authenticated account-owned generated draft images before campaign/template/revision exists. Reuse catalog and storage quota; no new ledger or assumed account funding support.

## Evidence and minimum design

`crates/df-assets/src/catalog_service.rs:246` refuses campaign None; advance at601 and publish at738 repeat it. Publication/rewrite/write_variant at732/773/832 carry CampaignId, and line842 constructs campaign_asset. Changing admission alone leaves drafts permanently stuck on recovery/publication.

`object_store.rs:153-195` requires CharacterRevision(account, template, revision) for character_asset. Add typed `StorageOwner::{Campaign(CampaignId), AccountDraft(AccountId)}` in this existing module and account_draft_asset with PrivateMedia key `<env>/users/<account>/draft-assets/<asset>/<attempt>/<write>/<variant>`. Preserve campaign layout byte-for-byte. Never fabricate a character revision, campaign, or account. Retain fresh WriteId, intent-before-put, fencing, winner verification and orphan cleanup. Thread validated owner through publish, missing-winner rewrites and write_variant, including restart paths. Quarantine layout stays unchanged.

Admission (`catalog_store.rs:35`) and AssetRecord (`catalog_record.rs:185`) already contain charge_scope, origin_account, nullable campaign, audience, dedupe_scope and retention. Derive ownership from these canonical fields instead of storing a redundant owner column. Add one shared validation helper callable by service and persistence; validate persisted account draft metadata again on recovery.

For the new no-campaign Generated Image branch require: QuotaScope::Account(A), origin_account Some(A), Audience::OwnerPrivate(A), DedupeScope::account(A), RetentionClass::Personal, and normal generated request-key presence. Refuse every mismatch before reservation/insertion/object I/O. Preserve Withheld -> AudienceEmpty. Unsupported no-campaign non-image generation remains refused. Scope this new guard carefully: do not accidentally reject existing Uploaded/Reviewed/library paths, or tighten existing campaign charge/origin semantics in this patch.

`catalog_fake.rs:238` and `df-persistence/src/media_catalog_sql/admission.rs:18` currently trust supplied metadata. Both must use the shared guard, not only CatalogService. `media_catalog.rs:47` admits within an existing finance transaction, bypassing service validation; no new finance behavior is authorized here.

## Quota, dedupe, retention and authorization

`quota.rs:10-13,41-66` already supports account storage bytes (100 MiB default). Existing finalization/tombstone transitions use row.charge_scope and quota-before-asset locking. Reuse reservations, actual-byte reconciliation, checked arithmetic, refusal rollback, terminal release and transactional outbox. This is storage capacity, not money or spend permission.

`df-persistence/migrations/0010_media_catalog.sql` already supports account scope/reservations, nullable campaign, OwnerPrivate audience/account, Personal retention and account_deletion tombstones. No schema migration is needed for this extension. Existing SQL row mapping supports these values.

`catalog_record.rs:103-128` DedupeScope is untagged 16-byte account/campaign identity. SQL live uniqueness is (dedupe_scope,request_key); `admission.rs:114` conflicting_row returns IDs/state without owner validation. For conflicts involving the new draft branch validate existing row ownership before returning Ready/InFlight; mismatch must fail without disclosing another owner's asset ID. Mirror fake behavior. Keep current index/request-key format; do not introduce a broad migration. Test forced identical raw account/campaign IDs and deliberately reused request keys, even though normal audience-aware keys distinguish them.

`catalog_service.rs:225-231` preflight lookup is an internal unauthenticated catalog read. Root must authorize the returned record before exposing asset/completion/content. Storage ownership is not delivery authorization. Account identity comes from authenticated context, never a client-provided arbitrary owner. Anonymous drafts need a separate explicit policy and are out of scope.

`audience.rs:47,85-96` OwnerPrivate only meets the same account; meeting campaign or another account becomes Withheld. Preserve this. Personal retention does not mean intermediate/quarantine. `catalog_sweep.rs:107-154` resumes in-progress rows through advance, but does not expire Ready personal assets. Do not invent a draft TTL. Explicit discard/account deletion use existing tombstone lifecycle; unreferenced Ready drafts continue consuming bytes until tombstoned. On character acceptance attach the real template revision reference, without silently widening audience, moving quota or rewriting keys. ## Acceptance cases

1. Valid account/no-campaign generated image admits and publishes expected PrivateMedia path; account reservation becomes actual committed bytes; campaign usage unchanged; metadata survives reload.
2. One-field mismatches (charge/origin/audience/dedupe/retention/kind/missing owner) refuse before side effects. Exercise direct fake and SQL admission, not only service. Existing uploads/reviewed/campaign cases retain behavior.
3. Same-account same-key Ready/InFlight dedupes with one reservation; different owners do not. Forced conflicting ownership never leaks IDs. Concurrent account admissions cannot oversubscribe quota.
4. Validation failure, oversize, rejection and terminal cancellation release once; repeated terminal calls do not double-credit. Storage outages remain recoverable.
5. Restart at Quarantined/Validated via existing sweep, lease loss, missing winning object rewrite and stale writer cleanup retain account owner/path and existing fencing.
6. Existing campaign keys/lifecycle fixtures remain unchanged. No-campaign unsupported kinds stay refused.
7. Explicit discard/account-deletion tombstone debits committed bytes once, respects live references, and deletes objects through existing grace/fence rules. No invented Ready-draft expiry.
8. Root integration: another account cannot request/read/subscribe/discard/reattach known draft AssetId or request key. OwnerPrivate/campaign reference meet remains Withheld. This storage patch alone cannot claim these authenticated tests pass.
